root_cause: The worker inherited Git trust for its service checkout but did not add the newly created task worktree. The first live agy run encountered dubious ownership and tried a global safe.directory change, which the headless command policy denied.
fix_summary: Append the task worktree's safe.directory setting only to the child process environment, preserving inherited Git configuration. Add an explicit agy_skip_permissions opt-in for implementation sessions following the user's authorization; writers retain normal permission checks.
